name: vozzy-native
description: Vozzy Native App (Capacitor wrapper for Android/iOS)

scripts.sync:android: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync ios
scripts.open:android: npm run sync:android && npx cap open android
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync:www && npx cap open ios
scripts.add:android: npm run sync:www && npx cap add android
scripts.add:ios: npm run sync:www && npx cap add ios
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
